lines.translation: #tr.en: Gilgameš arose to reveal a dream,
#tr.en: saying to his mother:
#tr.en: ‘O mother, during the course of this night

variants.reconstruction: %n šamhākū-ma | attanallak || ina birīt (|) eṭlūtim

lines.translation: #tr.en: I was walking about lustily in the company of young men.
#tr.en: The stars of the sky parted company,

manuscripts.atf: k[i-i]ṣ!-rum ša a-nim# im-qu₂-tam a-na ṣe-ri-ia

lines.translation: #tr.en: a lump of sky-rock fell down before me.
#tr.en: I picked it up but it grew too heavy for me,
#tr.en: I pushed at it but I could not move it.
#tr.en: The land of Uruk was gathered about it,
#tr.en: the young men kissing its feet.
#tr.en: I braced my forehead and they supported me,
#tr.en: I picked it up and carried it off to you.’
#tr.en: The mother of Gilgameš, well versed in everything,
#tr.en: said to Gilgameš:
#tr.en: ‘For sure, Gilgameš, one like yourself
#tr.en: was born in the wild and the upland reared him.
#tr.en: You will see him and you will rejoice,
#tr.en: the young men will kiss his feet.
#tr.en: You will hug him and bring him to me.’
#tr.en: He lay down and saw another dream.
#tr.en: He arose to talk to his mother:
